responsibility: Implements a compact sorted-set utility for function names used by analyzer checkers and models. It provides binary-search membership tests for raw names and file-scope/special function declarations, plus checking-only sanity assertions and selftests, making it a small reusable support component for quickly classifying APIs by name.
same_name_distinction: Implements the function_set operations declared in function-set.h, notably binary-search membership checks for names and decls plus checking/selftest support; unlike the header, it contains the executable lookup logic rather than just the lightweight set interface.
